Base\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    gender = Column(String, CheckConstraint(\"gender IN ('Male','Female','Unknown')\"))\n    intake_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Available\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('Available','Adopted','Foster','Medical Hold','Deceased')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Veterinarian(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"veterinarians\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    license_number = Column(String, unique=True)\n    clinic_name = Column(String)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass MedicalEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medical_events\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    event_type = Column(String, nullable=False, CheckConstraint(\"event_type IN ('Spay/Neuter','Vaccination','Checkup','Dental','Surgery','Injury','Illness','Other')\"))\n    event_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    veterinarian_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"veterinarians.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    animal = relationship(\"Animal\")\n    veterinarian = relationship(\"Veterinarian\")\n\n\nclass Vaccination(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"vaccinations\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    vaccine_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    vaccination_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    next_due_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Completed\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN       "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import MedicalEvent, Vaccination, Animal, Veterinarian\nfrom schemas import MedicalEventsMissingRabiesResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Animals\"])\n\n@router.get(\"/api/animals/medical-events/spay-neuter-missing-rabies\", \n           response_model=MedicalEventsMissingRabiesResponse,\n           operation_id=\"get_spay_neuter_missing_rabies_events\")\nasync def get_spay_neuter_missing_rabies_events(\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n    limit: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=1)\n):\n    # Calculate the date 6 months ago\n    six_months_ago = datetime.utcnow().date() - timedelta(days=180)\n    \n    # Subquery to find animals with recent spay/neuter events\n    spay_neuter_subq = (\n        db.query(MedicalEvent.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\",\n            MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n    \n    # Find animals that had spay/neuter but don't have a completed rabies vaccination\n    query = (\n        db.query(\n            Animal.id.label(\"animal_id\"),\n            Animal.name.label(\"animal_name\"),\n            MedicalEvent.event_date.label(\"surgery_date\"),\n            Vaccination.status.label(\"vaccination_status\"),\n            Vaccination.vaccination_date.label(\"last_vaccine_date\"),\n            Vaccination.next_due_date.label(\"next_due_date\"),\n            Veterinarian.name.label(\"veterinarian_name\")\n        )\n        .select_from(Animal)\n        .join(spay_neuter_subq, Animal.id == spay_neuter_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .join(MedicalEvent, MedicalEvent.animal_id == Animal.id)\n        .outerjoin(Vaccination, Vaccination.animal_id == Animal.id)\n        .outerjoin(Veterinarian, Veterinarian.id == MedicalEvent.veterinarian_id)\n        .filter(\n            MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\",\n            MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago,\n            Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\",\n            (Vaccination.status != \"Completed\") | (Vaccination.status.is_(None))\n        )\n    )\n    \n    if limit:\n        query = query.limit(limit)\n    \n    results = query.all()\n    \n    # Convert to list of dictionaries\n    records = []\n    for row in results:\n        records.append({\n            \"animal_id\": row.animal_id,\n            \"animal_name\": row.animal_name,\n            \"surgery_date\": row.surgery_date,\n            \"vaccination_status\": row.vaccination_status,\n            \"last_vaccine_date\": row.last_vaccine_date,\n            \"next_due_date\": row.next_due_date,\n            \"veterinarian_name\": row.veterinarian_name\n        })\n    \n    return {\"records\": records}"
    }
